messages:
Alex (CSM): FYI Suncrest dropped to almost zero after the final demo. dashboard shows ~88% drop in calls since Friday. anyone on this?
Priya (AE): I talked to Eli yesterday. They onboarded a new ML lead (Dana) whos running a competitive spike with HelixFlow this week.
Ben (Solutions Eng): any infra changes quoted on our side? last deploy notes?
Alex (CSM): quick audit: only a minor telemetry update 2025-12-10. no model swap. I ran: ```SELECT date, sum(requests) FROM api_calls WHERE account='suncrest' AND date>='2025-12-01' GROUP BY date;``` shows a cliff on 2025-12-12.
billing-bot: invoice SUN-2025-12 created 2025-12-11 status: unpaid
Dana (Suncrest): hi team we paused calls while security runs a short export/ingestion review. also HelixFlow's demo included a prefetch + token-pruning flow that looked cheaper on long docs.
sec-bot: security request logged: request-id=SR-3241 needs VPC diagram, KMS key policy, data-retention SLA.
Priya (AE): ok. action: send VPC/KMS + data-retention SLA and propose a short technical deep-dive. also offer a 5-day trial on a dedicated pool with prefetch enabled (no charge).
Ben (Solutions Eng): mitigation: enable prefix KV caching for their 2 primary templates, add adaptive chunking for 20k+ token inputs, and run a token-cost sim. I expect ~25-40% token reduction for their workload.
Alex (CSM): draft outreach: "Dana/Eli we can fast-track the security pack and run a 5-day dedicated trial with prefetch + adaptive chunking so you can compare token costs side-by-side with HelixFlow. can we book 30m tomorrow?"
Dana (Suncrest): that would help. security wants the VPC diagram first. can you include example KMS policies and a change-log for the last deploy?
Priya (AE): will assemble competitive comparison table vs HelixFlow and a champion slide showing trial terms.
Alex (CSM): Ben will prepare perf script + before/after token report. I'll send security/KMS docs today and schedule the call for tomorrow afternoon.
Eli (Suncrest): Friday 3pm works for our team. please include an SOC2 checklist in the doc pack.
billing-bot: payment reminder sent to customer billing contact.
Alex (CSM): recap action items: Alex -> send VPC/KMS + SOC2 checklist + schedule; Ben -> perf sim + KV config; Priya -> competitive pricing slide + contract flex for trial week.
Priya (AE): recommend we also include a clear success metric: >=30% token reduction and no more than 10% cost delta vs HelixFlow on typical fold jobs.
Alex (CSM): agreed. tagging this high priority and will update after the technical deep-dive. :spiral_calendar:
